Package game.positions.area

Interface TileCondition

All Known Implementing Classes:
BareOfItems, BreakableTile, EnterableBy, ForageableItems, HoldsActor, OutsideOf, PestPresent, PlantableTile, Unplanted, WaterableTile
public interface TileCondition
A condition that a tile may or may not meet, used to narrow an Area down (see Area.filter(TileCondition)).

Each way of narrowing an area is its own small class, so a new kind of condition is added by writing a new class, without changing Area.
